# Voxa - Full Context for AI

Voxa is a powerful AI meeting intelligence tool designed exclusively for Google Meet. It operates as a free Chrome extension, requiring no meeting bots to join your calls.

## Detailed Capabilities

### Recording & Transcription
- HD Meeting Recording
- Live Transcription (99% accuracy with custom vocabulary, supports 30+ languages)
- No bot joining the meeting (operates via Chrome extension)

### AI Intelligence
- AI Summary (Delivered within 30 seconds of meeting end)
- Smart Markers (Auto-detects financial figures, competitors, dates)
- Action Item Tracking (Auto-assigned to mentioned team members, smart deadline inference)

### Analytics & Insights
- Speaker Analytics (Talk-time distribution, engagement scoring, historical trend analysis)
- Attendance Tracking (Auto-detects who is speaking and for how long)

### Integrations & Workflow
- CRM Sync (Bi-directional sync with Salesforce and HubSpot)
- PDF Export

## Target Audience & Use Cases
- Sales Teams: Auto-sync notes to CRM, track next steps.
- Product Managers: Capture feature requests, document decisions.
- Engineering Teams: Document technical decisions.
- Startups: Keep stakeholders aligned without attending.
- Consultants: Generate client reports, track billable time.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- Is Voxa really free? Yes, completely free forever.
- Does it work on Zoom or Teams? No, exclusively Google Meet.
- Do I need a Workspace account? No, works with personal Google accounts too.
- Can I use it on mobile? No, desktop Chrome extension only.
